## How it was checked

- [ ] `npm run lint` and `npm run build` pass

## Content rules

- [ ] No invented fees, durations, certifications, placements, credentials, numbers or reviews
- [ ] Any new photograph goes through a slot in `data/images.ts` (no stock, no cropped posters)
- [ ] No secrets or client source documents committed
